page_title: VER 0-2 CAG | Verona v Cagliari 28/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.

90+3' 0 - 2 GOAL! A great pass finds Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) in acres of space after a fine counter attack. He brings the ball under control before firing it past the helpless keeper from close range. It’s now 0:2.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' The resulting set piece from Verona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
89' Darko Lazovic (Verona) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
85' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) brings down his opponent with a horror tackle and receives a straight red card from the referee!
85' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
83' Here is a change. Razvan Marin is going off and Davide Nicola gives the last tactical orders to Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari).
83' Today's match ends for Zito Luvumbo who will be replaced by Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari).
82' Mathis Lambourde (Verona) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
80' Verona keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
75' Substitution. Kingstone Mutandwa (Cagliari) on for Leonardo Pavoletti.
71' A cross into the box finds the head of Mathis Lambourde (Verona) who steers it goalwards, but Elia Caprile manages to pull off a decent save to thwart him.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) will replace Nicolas Valentini.
70' Paolo Zanetti decides to make a substitution. Suat Serdar will be replaced by Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona).
68' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
66' Rosario Abisso shows a yellow card to Diego Coppola (Verona) for his blatant foul.
64' Amin Sarr (Verona) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
63' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) is able to continue to play.
62' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
59' Paolo Zanetti has decided to substitute Daniel Mosquera and he is replaced by Mathis Lambourde (Verona).
58' Substitution. Domagoj Bradaric is replaced by Darko Lazovic (Verona).
57' Antoine Bernede (Verona) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
56' Verona keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
53' Wonderful movement. Daniel Mosquera (Verona) connects with a cross inside the box and plants a header goalwards, but Elia Caprile makes a superb save.
51' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
48' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) heads on.
46' The whistle blows and Rosario Abisso starts the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) hits a piledriver from long range, but the effort curls well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
43' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
43' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Elia Caprile intercepts the ball.
41' Ondrej Duda (Verona) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the left post only for Elia Caprile to dive and make a save.
40' What was Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
40' Rosario Abisso blows the whistle, Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) is penalised for a foul. It's a free kick to Verona, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
38' Ondrej Duda (Verona) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
38' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Verona force their opponents to concede a corner.
36' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
35' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
35' Ondrej Duda (Verona) tackles a bit over-zealously and Rosario Abisso blows for a foul. Cagliari are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
33' Referee Rosario Abisso points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Verona players.
33' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Verona players aren’t happy.

30' 0 - 1 What an excellent finish! Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) latched on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and rifled an unstoppable low drive into the middle of the net and past the helpless goalkeeper.
29' The resulting corner from Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) is cleared.
28' Tomas Suslov (Verona) is substituted due to injury. Paolo Zanetti gives a chance to Antoine Bernede.
28' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. It will be a corner kick for Cagliari.
23' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
23' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) commits a foul and Rosario Abisso immediately signals a free kick.

20' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Lorenzo Montipo pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
19' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) takes a great touch after receiving a pass inside the box. He immediately unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off a decent save!
17' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) tries to find Suat Serdar, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
16' Amin Sarr (Verona) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
15' Amin Sarr (Verona) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Rosario Abisso who sees an offensive foul.
12' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

11' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and Cagliari manage to earn a corner.
9' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
8' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Cagliari force a corner. They send men into the box.

8' Tomas Suslov (Verona) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome.
4' Ondrej Duda (Verona) takes the free kick and attempts to find some of his teammates inside the box, but the ball is intercepted and cleared out of danger.
3' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Verona will have the kick-off.
Rosario Abisso will officiate today.
